prompt:
Generate CHAR-01, a STATIC CHARACTER MASTER SHEET for the existing Civilization Town / Living Settlement project. Use the existing WORLD-01 village illustration as the shared world reference, but REPLACE the over-realistic human proportions from its first character lineup.

PLATFORM: Desktop asset-review board. Keep controls minimal; most of the page must be original character artwork.

STRUCTURE:
1. Small title "CHAR-01 / Citizen Masters - static neutral views".
2. One large original pixel-art turnaround image arranged as a precise 4-row by 4-column matrix. Rows are villager, farmer, lumberjack, builder. Columns, left to right, are NE (back looking right), NW (back looking left), SE (front looking right), SW (front looking left). Every cell contains the same full-body person for its row with consistent anatomy, clothes, hair and accessories. Exactly sixteen figures, all standing neutrally, none walking, swinging or carrying a load. Leave generous blank spacing between figures so each can be extracted independently.
3. Show the actual character sheet at large scale and add a smaller readability reference with each character approximately 48-54 pixels tall within a 64x64 canvas. Original imagery, not resized older rejected drawings.
4. Separate equipment tray: single-ended hoe, watering can, axe, short hammer, pickaxe, closed book, writing tool, carried stone, timber beam. Keep tools off the bodies in neutral masters. Label tools outside their image area.
5. A small front/back silhouette comparison; no more prose than necessary.

CONTENT / ANATOMY:
- Compact expressive JRPG-like village inhabitants: approximately three head-heights total, broad simple facial clusters. This is game sprite artwork, not realistic adult character concept painting, not an eight-head-tall anatomy study, not an oversized bobblehead.
- Continuous shoulder-upper arm-elbow-forearm-wrist shapes; both hands fully present and resting at the sides. Connected pelvis, both thighs and calves, planted boots; no floating limbs.
- Villager: youthful adult, simple tunic, short hair, belt pouch.
- Farmer: straw hat, tied apron over work clothes, boots.
- Lumberjack: sturdier torso, leather vest, short beard, boots.
- Builder: headband tied behind the head, rolled linen sleeves, short work apron.
- Four views must describe the same individual; do not mirror highlights or switch pouch sides arbitrarily.
- Use original generated illustration images, not CSS human shapes, font icons, emojis or stock art. Keep each image downloadable separately.
- Export image with actual transparency if supported; otherwise use a completely uniform background and explicitly report that alpha export is unavailable. Never draw a checkerboard into the image.
- Static only. No animation, no GIF, no work cycles or CSS transitions.
- Follow the existing project design system.

16-bit isometric pixel art character master turnaround sheet. No background texture, no paper grain, no gradient, no checkerboard, completely solid flat color #E7DABC.

Art style: Authentic 16-bit pixel art, crisp pixel clusters, compact expressive ~3-head-tall game sprite proportions (charming retro JRPG / classic isometric strategy game style, readable faces with calm neutral expressions, solid anatomy with continuous connected limbs, arms resting at sides in neutral standing pose). Upper-right lighting source, 1-pixel dark plum contour (#302C36), restrained 2-3 tone shading per material. 28-color Living Settlement palette (#59845A moss foliage, #527B8C muted blue, #65483C deep timber, #AD644D clay, #C2A05B straw, #DEA078 skin, #B28E65 soil).

The 4 rows (professions, top to bottom):
Row 1: Villager - Youthful adult, muted blue linen tunic (#527B8C), brown leather belt with side pouch on right hip, simple linen trousers, sturdy brown leather boots, neat short brown hair.
Row 2: Farmer - Broad woven straw hat (#C2A05B), olive-drab tied apron (#59845A / #385C46) over pale linen work shirt and trousers, boots. Neutral idle, no pitchfork in hands (tools kept separate).
Row 3: Lumberjack - Sturdier broad-shouldered torso, sleeveless dark leather vest (#65483C) over neutral linen undertunic, trimmed brown beard, rugged trousers, heavy boots. Neutral idle, arms resting at sides.
Row 4: Builder - Cloth headband tied behind dark hair, rolled-up linen shirt sleeves, leather carpenter work apron with small tool loop, sturdy work boots. Neutral standing pose.

The 4 columns (isometric turnaround angles, left to right):
Col 1: NE view (isometric rear-right / back looking right)
Col 2: NW view (isometric rear-left / back looking left)
Col 3: SE view (isometric front-right / front looking right)
Col 4: SW view (isometric front-left / front looking left)

Every character has consistent design across all 4 angles. Neutral idle stance with both arms resting naturally at sides, no swinging, no walking, no tools in hand, perfectly grounded feet. Pure static pixel art sprite sheet.
